acquisitionRule: All issuer-years FY2013..2025, including pre-window seed; earliest original annual report per year; corrections not selected automatically; retained bytes subtracted by receipt
carry: Strictly after release until superseded or identity termination; no backward fill
conflictRule: Highest-tier newest release cohort; conflicting assignments at same release are UNKNOWN until next unambiguous cohort; later single assignment supersedes only after release
identityRule: Dated issuer evidence required: filing title issuer plus exact filing stock code or source issuer identifier, tied to retained directory; retrospective bridge alone insufficient
unversionedExplicitLabels: Admit literal issuer label state but never claim standardized codebook grouping
